hero.title: See Aiken's outdoors *from the saddle*
hero.lede: Whether you are visiting for the weekend or you live nearby, ride one of our user-friendly horses with Annette Beeler and experience nature in a unique way. No prior riding experience needed.

facts.label: Rides are tailored to your experience

items.title: Tailored to you
items.text: Every ride is matched to your level of experience, from first-timers to seasoned riders.

items.title: Weight limit
items.text: There is a 250 lb. weight limit for riders.

items.title: Liability waiver
items.text: All riders are required to fill out a liability waiver before the ride.

sections.title: Riding with *Annette*
body: Annette Beeler has many years of experience and has always wanted to offer tourists and locals the chance to enjoy the outdoors on horseback.
You do not need any prior horseback riding experience, and we encourage riders at all levels to take a ride with us. While we have many horses, you may use your own.

quote.text: We are both novice riders but felt very comfortable with the horses and trails we explored with her. She was very friendly and welcoming, and our ride was exactly what we were looking for.

sections.title: Ready to ride?
sections.text: Please call for information on reserving a horse.

visit.title: Reserve *a horse*
visit.intro: Call, or send a note and include a contact number.
